evidence: Adds the `getscripthistory` RPC method with input parsing for raw scripts, addresses, and descriptors, plus query budget handling.
rationale: Adds `getscripthistory` to resolve a persistent limitation forcing node operators and wallet frontends to run third-party indexers. Address-based querying has been requested and attempted across numerous past PRs (#2802, #3652, #6835, #10370, #14053).
